_note: Explicit per-finish (per-SKU) tile-face swatches, applied by merge-formamondo-images.js AFTER the color merge. Keyed by pkey -> { <sku suffix>: <path under /wp-content/uploads/> }. Listing a pkey REPLACES its skus map, so finishes NOT listed fall back to the product (color) primary instead of a stale room-installation shot. Only finishes the site actually has a flat swatch for are listed; the rest (e.g. Double Beige Linear / Linear 3D Lux, White Linear 3D Lux) have no flat swatch on formamondo.com and inherit the color swatch.
